cases.name: global attribute reactions and mutation order
cases.action: (async()=>{const out=[];class EditingHints extends HTMLElement{static get observedAttributes(){return ['autocapitalize','autocorrect','writingsuggestions'];}attributeChangedCallback(name,oldValue,value){out.push(['reaction',name,oldValue,value]);}}customElements.define('editing-hints',EditingHints);const e=document.createElement('editing-hints');document.getElementById('container').append(e);const observer=new MutationObserver(records=>out.push(['observer',...records.map(r=>[r.attributeName,r.oldValue,r.attributeNamespace])]));observer.observe(e,{attributes:true,attributeOldValue:true});e.autocapitalize='words';out.push(['after',e.autocapitalize]);e.autocorrect=false;out.push(['after',e.autocorrect]);e.writingSuggestions='FALSE';out.push(['after',e.writingSuggestions]);e.autocapitalize='words';try{e.writingSuggestions=Symbol();}catch(err){out.push(['error',err.name,e.getAttribute('writingsuggestions')]);}await Promise.resolve();observer.disconnect();return JSON.stringify(out);})()
cases.difference: HTML HTMLElement IDL declares [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] autocapitalize. Chromium delays its reactions until a subsequent CEReactions operation or backup queue microtask.
